Orf6|RAE1.chains: SARS-CoV-2 ORF6 C-terminal tail + human RAE1 + human NUP98
Orf6|RAE1.interface_source: computed: ORF6 heavy-atom contacts with RAE1 <= 3.0 Å in PDB 7VPH
Orf6|RAE1.note: Experimental structure. ORF6 directly contacts RAE1 at the mRNA-export groove; the graph independently re-proposed this held-out edge and the structure confirms it.

Orf6|NUP98.chains: SARS-CoV-2 ORF6 C-terminal tail + human NUP98
Orf6|NUP98.interface_source: computed: ORF6 heavy-atom contacts with NUP98 <= 3.0 Å in PDB 7VPH
Orf6|NUP98.note: Experimental; known AP-MS edge shown for calibration.

Orf9b|TOMM70.interface_source: computed: ORF9b heavy-atom contacts with TOM70 <= 3.0 Å in PDB 7DHG
Orf9b|TOMM70.note: Experimental. S53 (the phospho-regulated serine) confirmed as a real contact; the prototype's S55/K46 are NOT contacts and were repaired.

N|G3BP1.chains: human G3BP1 (predicted monomer; the N–G3BP1 complex is not deposited)
N|G3BP1.interface_source: no deposited complex; specific N-protein contact residues are not shown (would be unverified). Binding is via the literature-verified ITFG/ΦxFG G3BP1-binding motif.
N|G3BP1.note: PREDICTED structure of the human G3BP1 target, shown to demonstrate the predicted-vs-experimental integrity path. Not the complex; not experimental fact.
